notes.title: CHANGES TO OUTPATH - FIRST JOURNEY
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A few days before I made an announcement telling to not play this version of the game since is outdated and could corrupt your normal save file.

But it has been of no use since many people continue to access this version without wanting to.

What I did in the end was make another Branch of the game, which you can select by following this little tutorial:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/52c0f451c1513f93b324fba59e8fbdb3f4f70c2a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/c4baf8145b16d5b5ad6cf007d31537c0a344f5c4.png[/img]

This way you can play the old version.
I have changed the default version to the demo version, which is compatible with the full game and will not break any save files.

I am sorry but I had so many false alarms about bugs and this was the reason.

You can buy the full game here with still a [b]10% discount[/b] if you want support my hard work!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237970/Outpath/

ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

Thanks for the support once again and have a good day/night.
David ːwinter2019happyyulː

notes.title: Outpath Devlog 8 - October 16th release date! 2 weeks left! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to the 8th Outpath devlog really good news!

This has being a long journey of highs and lows but I can finally tell the [b]release date[/b]!

[h1]October 16th 2023[/h1]
[i]Only 2 weeks to go!![/i]

[h3]Don't forget to add Outpath to your [b]wishlist[/b] to get notified![/h3] [i]It will help me a lot[/i] ːwinter2019happyyulː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237970/Outpath/

ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

I wanted to take a moment to express my heartfelt thanks for your patience and support. I'm thrilled to announce that I have completed the content for my game, and I can't wait for you to try it.

I've worked tirelessly to create a world of new experiences for players, and it's almost ready for you to enjoy.

Thank you all for making this possible. I'm excited to hear your feedback and see you dive into Outpath and see what you create, build and do!

I'am keeping some of the latest content under wraps to avoid spoilers and preserve the excitement for your gameplay experience.

[h3]Some FAQ:[/h3]

[b]How much will the game cost?[/b]
[i]The game will be available for $15, with localized prices. It will have a 10% discount upon launch.[/i]

[b]How many hours does the game last?[/b]
[i]The game offers around 20-25 hours of constant new content. However, you can keep improving, building, and optimizing infinitely.
[/i]
[b]Is the game complete?[/b]
[i]Yes, the game has enough content to provide a complete experience. Additionally, once it is released, I plan to continue updating, improving, and adding more based on your feedback, as it will be much easier to balance, create, or expand. Your feedback is essential![/i]

Thanks for playing the prologue and the demo, have a nice day/night.
David ːwinter2019happyyulː

notes.title: Outpath Devlog 7 - 1 month until RELEASE!🎉🎊
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the 7th Outpath devlog, good news! The game will be officially launch this coming [b]early/mid October 2023[/b]. Only 1 month to go!
I can't say the day because I still need to polish the game before telling the exact day but its in a really good shape!

[h3]Don't forget to add Outpath to your wishlist to get notified! It will help me a lot ːwinter2019happyyulː[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237970/Outpath/

ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

[h3]I have been working on a lot of things. Here are some I added/changed:[/h3]

Almost all main content is finished! That means once I finish balancing and bug fixing, I will start adding extra secondary content like more decorations, customizations, features, etc. Right now I am polishing the last biome, here is a screenshot of how it looks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/049877f66ccd141f5f41f36d101ab76a71f0c3de.png[/img]

You can now regenerate entire islands! I love this so much because if you don't like how 1 island generated, now you can change it with 1 magic item, the "Island Eater".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/6a003f6703e9195cc2dd70592d06fbe41989b671.png[/img]

I also worked a lot on thinking and coding unique skills to a total of 50 unique skills! They work so well together that I love how well they turned out.
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2024986142286808432/26962BD3294646EC993E8C5025732D87B040783B/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

I also made like 15 more builds, some of them are in this picture, they have unique effects too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43345075/11dbaaa9cbd479b22652407074cc38ab94628c41.png[/img]

I am working +12 hours each day on this game doing really good progress so don't worry about the state of the game, its more live than ever <3
Some people have already played the [b]beta[/b] and [b]said it way better than the demo[/b]! I hope you will enjoy it as much as me ːwinter2019happyyulː

For now the game doesn't have combat and I might stick with it until release. I might add it later on like with an update but I am not sure since I really like Outpath having this chill vibe.

Thanks for playing my game, have a nice day/night.
David ːwinter2019happyyulː

notes.title: Update 1.0.10 - Distant islands now work!

A lot of people asked this and here it is! You can now enable or disable distant islands so structures can work even if you are in another island. Be careful because having this option enabled can cause lag.
ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

+ Added an option to enable/disable distant islands.

* Fixed some typos.

Thanks for the support.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 - 2 new languages & important bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, David here! 

An update fixing important and not so important bugs but still necessary to do.
ːwinter2019happybulbː [url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]
+ Added new languages:
[list]
[*] Italian
[*] Ukranian
[/list][i](NOTE: There may still be problems with some translations.)[/i]

* Unique items like Artifact or Tools can only be crafted once.
* Fixed bugs when equipping only a Hammer.
* Now structures keep the rotation correctly.
* Now collection nets shows the correct color when placing.
* Collection nets no longer show an arrow once placed.
* Russian flag now appears correctly.
* Auto-save now saves correctly.
* When loading games, the player will no longer be infinitely falling into the water.
* Tweaked some translation terms.
* Changed chinese font (it may be more readable).
* Now switching to a weapon adds 0.5 seconds before it can be used.
* Now pressing ESC will exit screenshot mode.
* Tutorial will no longer appear when loading a game.
* Tweaked some colors of plants for people with color blindness.

Thanks for playing my game, have a nice day/night and Merry Christmas!

David ːwinter2019happyyulː

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - NEW remove builds tool & lots of QoL
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I read a lot of feedback from you and here are some changes and new features I added today. I am glad you are liking my game so much!<3

[url=https://discord.com/invite/H4uGewvB4Q]Check the Official Discord[/url] where I am always active.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]
+ Now structures can be removed with a new tool.
+ Added a panel for patch notes.
+ Added background to some menus.
+ Added brightness option.
+ Added invert mouse axis option.
+ Added 'Hold Click' mode in options menu.
+ Added 2k & 4k resolutions support.
+ Added option to hide pickup alerts.

* Now higher tier tools will replace older tools.
* Fixed some numbers appearing incorrectly.
* Now structures show their radius by default.
* Increased cost of Jump Pad & Collection Net.
* Increased trash needed to craft iron & gold ores.
* Newer structures cost now scales exponentially.
* Fixed auto clicking some structures that you shouldn't be able to do it.
* Fixed 'escape' button bug in key bindings.
* Increased max mouse sensitivity in options.
* Fixed some tutorial bugs.
* Handy Skill now changes swords and bug nets correctly.
* Jump pad now needs to be unlocked.
* Fixed bug where player could fall to water when teleported.

Have a good day/night everyone ^^
David
